dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Jeremiah Thee Bullfrog arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Jeremiah has been observed to quickly become overaroused. Noted to jump up on handlers and head whip to mouth their hands. Jeremiah is also noted to take treats with very hard pressure. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Jeremiah Thee Bullfrog
